subject: [RFC PATCH 57/57] MAINTAINERS: add an entry for collapse

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Suggested that the patch should have the same maintainers and reviewers as the rest of THP, implying that the current maintainership is not clear.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Lorenzo's suggestion, implying that the current maintainership is unclear.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to extract the THP collapse logic into a separate module, mm/collapse.c, and update the MAINTAINERS file accordingly. The patch aims to provide a clear separation of concerns for the THP collapse functionality.
